comment: Absolutely wonderful. Dr. Howell is very engaging, the readings are extremely interesting, and she is very willing to help students. Lots of class discussion and group work, which worked really well with the material.

FYS was pretty easy with Howell. She is passionate and energetic even when students are unresponsive. Go to office hours before an essay and she will basically make you an outline. Not too much work and very forgiving and understanding. Overall can't complain.
AMAZING PROFESSOR!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Getting a good grade will not be a walk in the park, but if you genuinely try, you won't struggle much, if at all. You likely won't have a lot of classmates, especially if your goal is to get into the higher levels and get that COM2 requirement. Super fun, super engaging, AND classes are only fifty minutes, four days a week!

Great professor! I did the 322 class, which included a lot of fun reading, and her classes always tied in different concepts, ideas, and history to the literature. As a person, she is very fun and caring, making sure to have a personal connection with every student.

GS290: no textbook, but have readings with worksheets and group projects. Very interesting person and she makes the class interesting. I would try and talk with her after class so she knows you and knows what you are interested in. Kinda crazy :)

Prof. Howell is really a character! She is a good teacher who cares about her students. Can be unorganized at times/ tends to cancel class pretty often. Her FYS course is not difficult but assignments can be confusing because she doesn't give clear instructions. Good professor, great personality.

Dr. Howell is great as a Russian professor. She does set homework every night which can sometimes be a challenge but it's usually doable. She is very patient and will do all she can to help you learn and she's also very accessible for help with general things beyond just the Russian language. She's always happy to help you out.

Professor Howell has been my favorite professor at UR so far. She's super nice and really cares about you succeeding. Idk why I took Russian, but I haven't regretted it at all because of her. 100% would recommend.

Dr. Howell is my absolute favorite professor at UR. She cares more about making sure her students learn the material than establishing clear grades so she's flexible about grades as long as you're making a clear effort to learn the material. She does everything she can to meet each student's individual learning styles/needs and she's also hilarious

Professor Howell is an amazing professor and person. She has a great sense of humor and her lectures are filled with necessary information, but also interesting and funny personal anecdotes from her time in the Soviet Union. She was a very fair, and easy grader. Take home midterm, final group project, and 4-5 short response papers on readings.

Super passionate about a lot of topics and her enthusiasm rubs off on you. Excellent at facilitating discussions by moving them in directions that stretch how you perceive things. Very reasonable teacher and grader. Even though I'm not pursuing a degree in anything Russia-related I'm considering taking another one of her classes just because.
Very relaxed about due dates. Interacts with the class as if she's one of us. Awesome professor.

Prof Howell is awesome. Due dates are honestly suggestions not mandatory. I am an athlete, so that was clutch. Lots of reading and writing but it's an FYS. Probably the easist FYS that ive heard about
she's great and really gets you involved in her discussions.. classes are basically reviewing the reading and talking about it. lots of writing (like any fys) but interesting topics.

BY far the most wonderful professor imaginable. She genuinely cares about all her students in what she calls "our little Russian family" and will ensure that you not only do well in her class but also have the time of your life. A genuinely brilliant intellectual and a wonderfully warm and empathetic person who you can truly look up to as a mentor.

A very cool and inspiring teacher - does not get caught up with due dates or sticking to an exact schedule. If adjusting what we are learning or doing that day will help her students learn better she will do it. A very intelligent person herself, able to make complex concepts more understandable.  Overall: helpful, chill, and willing to work with u
Love the class. You need to work but you will learn.

I took several classes of hers over 15 years ago.  I still remember when she would pepper me with questions in Russian while Dr. Bonfiglio would do the same in German.  I grew to love her classes, and I still enjoy learning about the langauge and culture.  Her love of the culture is inspiring, and one that, for me, will continue on in life.
managed to make core even worse

Obsessed with Russia, which sometimes makes the class interesting and sometimes not. Usually, the class is boring, however, she is a nice person and great fun to hang out with. Sometimes unorganized. Easy history requirement. DO NOT take russian literature with her, u'll be asleep every class.

Easy way to fullfill history requirement. She is very unorganized in the way she teaches, jumping from place to place all the time. She doesn't teach like a teacher, it seems like she is obsessed with Russia and is just telling us what she read about it and the few times she visited.

You get the material and then some in the most far-out/entertaining style of teaching that I have ever encountered.  GREAT teacher of GREAT classes, work your schedule around whatever class she is teaching that semester, it's well worth it.

Yvonne is an awesome professor.  I have had 7 classes with her, and she just gets better with time.  Very helpful, and incredibly funny.  Great discussions in class, especially those with nothing to do with Russian language.  Will provide lots of sketchy information about Russian culture/smuggling
Great personality, sense of humor, and a really smart woman. Probably my favorite teacher here. Take this class with her. You won't regret it.
I took Russian out of spite for the German profs, and LOVED it.  Yvonne was so much fun -- really made learning a treat!
she is GREAT for core... and just a very smart woman!
brilliant professor. Just talk to her and you'll find she is a wealth of information.

Wonderful person and good teacher.
She may digress, but she minimizes the pain from core as much as possible
